words.alt: The giant in the story is taller than a house.
words.prompt: Use case: a picture card that teaches a seven-year-old the English word “giant”. Paint one clear, simple scene showing this sentence: “The giant in the story is taller than a house.”. The meaning of “giant” must be obvious at a glance: make it big and central, with a calm, uncluttered background. Painted children’s picture-book style like image 1, warm light, friendly faces. Image 1 is a style reference only; do not copy its fox, tunnel or layout. Image 2 is Gus, a friendly giant; keep his look exactly. Show him as a true giant standing beside a small cottage, his head far above its roof. Landscape 3:2, full scene edge to edge. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no speech bubbles, no borders, no panels; book pages show only soft wavy lines. Child-friendly.
